instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Grace Mensah. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Grace Mensah. Do not return images or details of anyone.

Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Care/Grace Mensah - nights.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. List any page or line that could not be read.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-03 00:00 to 2026-11-05 12:00 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Grace Mensah and limit 500. Return every event with its event id, local time, camera and the identity name exactly as recorded, and say whether the list was cut at the limit. Read only. Do not return events of any other person. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

said:
Fair Hours: Grace Mensah, 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-04 (America/New_York)

Bill: Care/Grace Mensah - nights.pdf. Cameras: Front Door (entrance). Tolerance: 10 min, no agreed terms. The period is the first and last billed dates on the bill.

| Tue 2026-11-03 | 22:00-06:00 (8 h 00 min) | 21:58-06:03 next day (8 h 05 min) | 5 min seen longer than billed, within tolerance | Confirmed | 2 events |
| Wed 2026-11-04 | 22:00-06:00 (8 h 00 min) | 21:57-06:04 next day (8 h 07 min) | 7 min seen longer than billed, within tolerance | Confirmed | 2 events |

Totals

Bill arithmetic: all lines check. 8 h x $30 = $240 per line, and $240 + $240 = $480, which matches the printed total (USD). The bill lines print no worker name, so both were compared as the helper lines.

What this means: both overnight visits matched the Front Door recognitions within the 10-minute tolerance. The cameras saw 5 and 7 minutes more than the bill in each case. Camera times show passages through the front door, not the work done inside, so they do not show how the hours were spent. There are no rows outside Confirmed, so no snapshots are needed.
